title: 7ecb(a): GCP OSCORE identity plane mix — self uses routable low-half, peers use SHA-512 IID
description: Cluster 1 of 7ecb. rust/lichen-gateway/src/gateway.rs:1154 (install_gcp_context) and :1211 (provision_closed_federation) derive local_iid = self.coordinator.info.iid[8..] — the ROUTABLE /128's AddrForKey key-material low half — while peer identity uses iid_from_pubkey_bytes (SHA-512 IID). Consequences: (1) federation pairwise OSCORE contexts cannot mirror between two gateways (sender_id/recipient_id swapped per trust.rs:1359); (2) the LocalPeer self-guard at :1218 compares SHA-512 peer_iid against routable local_iid, so self-peering fails OPEN. FIX: use the SHA-512 IID (iid_from_pubkey_bytes of the local pubkey) for local_iid in both functions so both ends are the same plane. Verify the local pubkey is reachable at these sites (trust_store/coordinator). Add/adjust a test that two gateways derive mutually-mirroring contexts. cargo test -p lichen-gateway green.
close_reason: Fixed GCP OSCORE identity plane mix. Added SecureStack::local_iid() (secure.rs) + RplStack::local_iid() (rpl_stack/mod.rs) = SHA-512 IID of local pubkey (same plane as peer iid_from_pubkey_bytes). install_gcp_context (gateway.rs:1159) and provision_closed_federation (gateway.rs:1218) now use rpl_stack.local_iid() instead of the routable /128's low half (coordinator.info.iid[8..]). This restores OSCORE sender/recipient ID mirroring between two gateways and makes the LocalPeer self-guard reject self-peering (was fail-open). Tests: provision_closed_federation_rejects_self_peering + gcp_contexts_install_mutually_between_gateways (mutual install on persistent gateways). cargo test -p lichen-gateway --lib: 273 passed (was 271, +2 new), 0 failed. lichen-node --lib: 6 failures = exact pre-existing nnmc/5217 set, unchanged from HEAD. 3x codereview (correctness/security/edge) done in-session after opencode-run reviewer timed out twice: PASS x3 — IID plane verified consistent end-to-end (derive_context -> install_gcp_context), trust-store check untouched, local_iid() infallible. Clusters 7ecb.2 (tunnel-auth egress) + 7ecb.3 (slot tiebreak) filed separately.
